summary: HUTCHMED (China) Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the timing of its 2026 half-year financial results release and webcast presentations. The filing is a routine earnings notice, not a special situation event. It provides details on the results announcement date (July 30, 2026) and management webcasts in English and Chinese. No transaction, activist activity, strategic review, capital return, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a standard periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
